label: VERIFIED
source: Xu, Xie, Exoo, Radziszowski, Constructive lower bounds on classical multicolor Ramsey numbers, Electron. J. Combin. 11 (2004) #R35, Theorem 7 (p.11) and its proof (pp.11-12) (survey item 6.2.g, p.58, references XuX2 and XXER), applied to M. Kolodyazhny, New lower bounds for Ramsey numbers (in Russian), article 17 of the Aluarium forum, dated 31 March 2016 (the survey's reference Kol2), the (3,15;73) graph printed on that page, read from the same three Wayback Machine captures as the R(3,14) row (phase2/witnesses/inputs/R3_15_n73_Kol2.colormat.gz)
how: built here from the input by the coloring F in the proof of Theorem 7 (pp.11-12), on four copies of the input's 73 vertices. Two implementations, phase2/scripts_as_run/build_r3316_292/build_xxer7.py (the function xxer_quadruple of phase2/scripts_as_run/build_G1_G2/scripts/constructions.py) and xxer7_indep.py (written from the paper's text, no shared code), give byte-identical files. In the file digit 0 is the paper's color 1, digit 1 color 2 and digit 2 color 3
license: built here (MIT, this repository), construction credited to its authors and the input to Kolodyazhny. A request to change the credit or remove the file is handled as described in CORRECTIONS.md
checks: Input (3,15;73): clique.c and gen0 on the whole graph, no reduction: no triangle and no independent set of 15 vertices, with controls (13 November), and verify_ramsey PASS (13 and 18 November). Witness (3,3,16;292): clique.c and gen0 on every color, whole graph, no reduction: NONE 2, NONE 2, NONE 15 (clique.c 359 s and gen0 10.5 s for the K_16 question). verify_ramsey PASS on the committed .gz (365 s). Controls for every color: a copy with one edge recolored is caught by both checkers, and both find a K_15 in color 3. The K_16 question was also answered on 13 November by an exact split into 292 pieces, with both checkers. Cloud, 13 November, rerun 18 November. Logs: phase2/checks/logs/build_r3316_292/
notes: Not one of the 105 cells: the survey's value 291 for R(3,3,16) has a public witness (Exoo and Tatarevic's g3316.290, phase 1). Table XIb lists R(3,3,16) >= 291 [ExT]. Item 6.2.g, R(3,k,l) >= 4R(k,l-1) - 3 [XuX2, XXER], with R(3,15) >= 74 [Kol2] (Tables Ia and IIa) gives 4*74 - 3 = 293. This is not a new bound. It is a checked, explicit coloring for the value the survey's own items give
